name: sqlite-3.27-subqueries
query:
SELECT c.email, s.spent,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id, sum(total) AS spent
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) s ON s.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.country = 'JP'
  AND s.spent > (SELECT avg(total) * 12 FROM orders)
rows: SCAN TABLE orders USING INDEX orders_customer_id_idx
SEARCH TABLE customers AS c USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH TABLE orders AS o2 USING COVERING INDEX orders_customer_id_idx (customer_id=?)
